meta_title: Limuka Painters & Decorators | House Painter Leeds
meta_description: Limuka Painters & Decorators in Leeds. Interior and exterior painting, decorating, and wall finishes. Free quotes, fully insured. Call 07463 369911.
hero_subhead: From tired walls to stunning finishes. We transform homes and businesses across Leeds with precision and care.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Leeds
services_subhead: Whether it's a single room refresh or a full commercial project, we handle interior and exterior work with meticulous attention to detail.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: We paint bedrooms, living rooms, kitchens, and hallways using premium finishes that last. Every room is properly prepared, protected, and finished to leave your home spotless.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Cladding
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior paints for fascias, soffits, doors, and garden walls. We use quality products that resist Leeds' damp climate and look fresh for years.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging & Removal
services.desc: Expert wallpaper installation on feature walls or full rooms, plus careful removal of old coverings without damage to plaster. We source and hang modern designs or heritage papers.

services.title: Commercial & Office Redecorating
services.desc: Quick turnaround painting for shops, offices, and warehouses. We work around your business hours to minimise disruption and restore professional appearance.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishes
services.desc: Doors, skirting boards, stairs, and built-in cupboards painted to an immaculate standard. We prepare, prime, and apply multiple coats for a durable, smooth finish.

services.title: Colour Consultation & Design
services.desc: Unsure which colours work? We advise on paint selection, finishes, and design schemes to suit your home and create rooms you'll love living in.

about_pullquote: We show up on time, do the job right, and respect your home like it's our own.
about_para_1: Limuka Painters & Decorators was founded over 15 years ago by a team frustrated with cowboys who left mess and missed deadlines. We built the business on reliability, quality materials, and proper preparation—the foundations of any job that lasts. Today, we've completed over 2,000 projects across Leeds and beyond, from Victorian terrace renovations to modern apartment schemes.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we listen, prepare surfaces thoroughly (not a shortcut in sight), and finish with care. We're fully insured, use premium paints and products, and stand behind every job. Whether you need a bedroom refresh or a full commercial redecorating, you'll find us straightforward, punctual, and genuinely interested in the result.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Brilliant job on our lounge. Came in for a quote, gave us a fixed price, and got on with it. They moved furniture carefully, protected everything, and cleaned up every single day. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: David K.

reviews.text: Had the whole downstairs painted while we were away for the weekend. Came back to a perfect finish and the house spotless. The colour advice they gave us beforehand made all the difference. Top blokes.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Used them for our shop frontage. Professional, on schedule, and didn't fuss about the tight timescale. The paintwork looks sharp and they treated my business with real respect. Will use again next year.
reviews.author: Rajesh P.
